function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to event calendars, so I can’t tell you exactly which festival is happening next in the United States. However, here’s a quick rundown of some of the big, recurring festivals that usually take place in the coming months (based on the 2026–2027 calendar). You can check their official websites for the most up‑to‑date dates, locations, and ticket information:

| Festival | Typical Dates (2027) | Location | What to Expect | Ticket Price (approx.) | Official Site |
|----------|----------------------|----------|----------------|------------------------|---------------|
| **New Year’s Eve in Times Square** | Dec 31, 2026 | New York City, NY | Countdown, fireworks, live music, massive crowds | Free (but you’ll need to register for a spot) | [timesquare.com](https://www.timesquare.com) |
| **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | Apr 20‑22, 2027 | Indio, CA | Multi‑genre music, art installations, food trucks | $600–$700 (3‑day pass) | [coachella.com](https://www.coachella.com) |
| **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | Jun 8‑10, 2027 | Manchester, TN | Indie, rock, hip‑hop, comedy, art | $500–$600 (3‑day pass) | [bonnaroo.com](https://www.bonnaroo.com) |
| **Lollapalooza Chicago** | Aug 4‑6, 2027 | Chicago, IL | Pop, rock, electronic, world music | $200–$250 (3‑day pass) | [lollapalooza.com](https://www.lollapalooza.com) |
| **South by Southwest (SXSW)** | Mar 11‑13, 2027 | Austin, TX | Film, music, interactive media | $300–$350 (3‑day pass) | [sbx.com](https://www.sbx.com) |
| **Burning Man** | Aug 27‑Sep 4, 2027 | Black Rock Desert, NV | Art, music, community, self‑expression | $1,000–$1,200 (ticket + registration) | [burningman.org](https://www.burningman.org) |
| **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | May 12‑15, 2027 | New Orleans, LA | Jazz, blues, Cajun, Creole, food | $150–$200 (3‑day pass) | [jazzfest.com](https://www.jazzfest.com) |

### How to find the exact “next” festival

1. **Check the official website** – Most festivals post their 2027 dates early in the year.  
2. **Use a local events calendar** – Sites like Eventbrite, Meetup, or city tourism pages list upcoming festivals.  
3. **Search news outlets** – Local newspapers often publish “What’s happening this weekend” sections.  

If you let me know what kind of festival you’re interested in (music, food, cultural, etc.) or a specific region, I can narrow down the list further.
